")).decode("utf-8")
s=s.replace(marker,patch+marker,1)
s=s.replace("V9-9.0 · Firebase 실시간 수업","V9-9.1 · Firebase 실시간 수업")
s=s.replace("'V9-9.0 실시간'","'V9-9.1 실시간'")
s=s.replace('<span class="version-badge">V9-9.0</span>','<span class="version-badge">V9-9.1</span>')
s=s.replace("?student=1&v=990","?student=1&v=991")
s=s.replace("&v=990","&v=991")
# Structural checks
required=["장면·에피소드별 기록","장면·에피소드 목록","data-v991-scene-map","data-v991-focus-scene","sceneMoodContext991","V9-9.1"]
for x in required:
    if x not in s: raise SystemExit(f"missing V9-9.1 marker: {x}")
if s.count("const V991='V9-9.1'")!=1:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected V991 marker count")
# Syntax-check every inline JS block
parts=re.findall(r'<script(?:\s[^>]*)?>([\s\S]*?)</script>',s,re.I)
for i,js in enumerate(parts):
    q=Path(f'/tmp/drb_v991_{i}.js'); q.write_text(js,encoding='utf-8')
    subprocess.run(['node','--check',str(q)],check=True)
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
print('V9-9.1 applied; JS syntax checks passed')
